direct_human_requirement: prd给我加上，放在网站上的这个AI辅助设计的功能是面向用户，不要展示其他不相关的信息和功能。另外用户提交自己的设计之后，会由我们先进行审核，有AI审核和人工审核，如果比较简单的工艺和结构我们可以用AI直接审批是否可做，如果AI审批过后不行会提交给设计师审核并通过邮件联系确定和沟通需求
interpretation: Customer-facing feature only; unrelated internal/admin information stays private

AI non-pass/uncertain/complex and post-approval infeasibility all escalate to designer
Designer uses service email to clarify, revise and confirm requirements
Feasibility approval separate from manufacturing qualification; resin and metal independently qualified
not_executed: AI generation or review API call
